validation_goal: Check whether intervention magnitudes are supported by historical data.
main_result: Green 5/10/20 pp increments fall within observed historical change range; NDBI and NDWI levels were independently reproduced from historical quantiles.

validation_goal: Check whether historical within-grid response directions are stable.
main_result: NDBI showed a stable positive association with LST; NDWI showed a stable negative association; green-cover association remained positive in both full-period and sensitivity models.

validation_goal: Check scenario completeness, arithmetic identities, bounds, direction labels and historical directional agreement.
main_result: All structural, arithmetic and formula checks passed and all three scenario families agreed with historical directional evidence.

validation_goal: Assess whether scenario outputs are data-supported and internally robust.
main_result: Scenario framework is data-supported and internally consistent; outputs remain model-based what-if estimates and are not causal or future ground-truth predictions.
